text:
About Elijah (11):
* hearing loss, wears hearing aids in both ears. If they squeal the battery is low, spares in his bag.
* he doesn't need an interpreter, he lip-reads, just face him when you talk.
* anxiety, mostly about loud surprises. If the fire alarm goes off he freezes and cannot hear instructions, someone has to walk him out by the hand.
* pickup: me or his stepdad Chris. It's not that his uncle Ray can't pick him up, he can, he's on the list, he just never does.

traps.why: "It's not that Ray can't pick him up" means Ray CAN; saying he can't is wrong.
He doesn't need an interpreter; he lip-reads.
